capabilities: Apply one Mermaid theme, font, spacing, and layout configuration across the vault
Open diagrams in a pan-and-zoom viewer unconstrained by note width
Pan and zoom via mouse drag, wheel, keyboard, toolbar, or touch gestures
Validate Mermaid configuration before saving and keep the last valid config on failure
Choose single-click, double-click, or expand-button activation and follow in-diagram links
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or later; the marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Warns that other plugins initializing Mermaid may override the shared configuration depending on load order.
intentEvidence: Mermaid Lens modifies Obsidian's shared Mermaid configuration.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams constrained to the note width with no shared vault-wide configuration, making large diagrams hard to read and styling inconsistent.

relations.evidence: The value must be a JSON object accepted by Mermaid's initialize() API.

summary: Mermaid enhancer that applies one global Mermaid configuration vault-wide and opens diagrams in a draggable, zoomable viewer.
